description: Bean qou-slvl item 2. Derives BOTH connection-matrix recursions from the C1 operator L = (p^4z^2-1)tau^2 - (p^2-1)tau - (p^2-1), removing the last defined-to-match inputs in QOU/QBeta/C1SeriesConvergence.lean. Neither side is a bare power series: the 0-side carries e_t = theta_p(z)/theta_p(z/t) with tau e_t = t e_t, the inf-side carries 1/theta_p(z/T) with tau acting by T/z — both from the theta functional equation — and after dividing them out the brackets are polynomial. Checks that the coefficient of each power is exactly the four-term collection Lean calls zeroCoeffAt / infCoeffAt, and that solving for the top coefficient returns gc() and hc() of c3_w2_c1_pole_divisor.py verbatim.

computation.infSideAnsatz: y_inf = (sum_k h_k z^-k) / theta_p(z/T), worked in u = 1/z

checks.name: zero_side_coefficient_is_the_four_term_collection
checks.detail: coeff(z^(k+2)) of L y_0 / e_t equals zeroCoeffAt for k=0..9, symbolic g_k

checks.name: zero_side_recursion_matches_script_gc
checks.detail: solving coeff(z^k)=0 for g_k returns gc()'s recursion (q = p^2) for k=2..9

checks.name: inf_side_coefficient_is_the_four_term_collection
checks.detail: coeff(u^(k+2)), u = 1/z, of the inf-side bracket equals infCoeffAt for k=0..9

checks.name: inf_side_recursion_matches_script_hc
checks.detail: solving coeff(u^k)=0 for h_k returns hc()'s recursion for k=2..9

verdict: Both recursions are consequences of the operator, not stipulations. The coefficient collections match Lean's zeroCoeffAt / infCoeffAt exactly, and solving them returns the pole-divisor script's gc() and hc() verbatim. With Lean's zeroCoeffAt_eq_zero_iff and infCoeffAt_eq_zero_iff, summable_zeroSideCoeff and summable_infSideCoeff are now statements about the actual Y_0 and Y_inf series. Still NOT established: that these series, times their theta prefactors, are the canonical solutions at 0 and infinity — that is qou-c1ln row 4. Nothing wired to production.
